top_signals.title: Japan Tobacco Climbs on Potential Imperial Brands Takeover
top_signals.summary: Japan Tobacco Inc. shares rose on news that it is exploring a potential takeover of Imperial Brands Plc with Altria Group Inc., a move that could help the Japanese cigarette maker fill a large earnings hole left by the recent seizure of its Russian assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
